title: Step Taken Off for Insured Legs Already Charged
content:
# Tariff Rider: The Step Taken Off for Insured Legs Already Charged

This rider fixes the step taken off the insured shipping rate on a work order of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service by reference to the insured legs already standing charged on that order.

| Insured legs already standing charged on the work order | Step taken off |
|---|---|
| Two or more | the frequent-leg step, 30 percent |
| Exactly one | the return-leg step, 15 percent |
| None | no step is taken off on this ground |

**The rider in words.** Where two or more insured legs already stand charged on the work order, the frequent-leg step of 30 percent is taken off; where exactly one insured leg already stands charged on it, the return-leg step of 15 percent is taken off. In any other case no step is taken off on this ground.

**On the count.** What is counted is the insured shipping legs already standing charged on that work order at the handling date, over the whole life of the order. The leg now being charged is not among them.

**Hypothetical readings.** A work order carrying no insured leg yet takes no step off on this ground. One carrying a single insured leg already charged takes the return-leg step of 15 percent off. One carrying three insured legs already charged takes the frequent-leg step of 30 percent off.
